name: kong-cost-model-limit
description: Test 3 on Kong OSS 3.9.3, run through run-cost.sh with a throwaway consumer (its limit in the run's meta.json note). 1 request a minute on the Gemini route only (a plugin scoped to the consumer and the gemini-chat route), policy local. A per-model request limit: expect Gemini answered once, then refused, while Claude, on a route with no limit for this consumer, still answers.
